items.t: Scotia Metals Expands Lithium Footprint With Brazilian Project Acquisition Option
items.sum: Scotia Metals Corp. (CSE: SMET) (OTCQB: CSRVF) (FSE: C6R0) is expanding its lithium exploration portfolio into Brazil, securing an option to acquire a 100% interest in the Nordestina Lithium Project in Bahia State. The proposed acquisition gives the company exposure to a second hard-rock lithium asset as it advances exploration at its existing Acadia Project […]

items.t: Inside the Army’s 75 Year Plan to Escape China’s Rare Earth Dominance
